name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - § 79, après le point l - Am 178
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 79b. Reiterates its call on the Bureau to revise the rules and to introduce a cooling-off period for former Members during which they cannot engage in lobbying or representational activities with the Parliament equal to the time during which they receive a transitional allowance;
